packageRules.description: examples/ui5 is dormant: it uses its own disconnected toolchain (jest/ts-jest/ts-node, not this workspace's vitest) and has no 'build'/'test' script, so it's excluded from every routine build/test/CI script here - nothing would ever verify a Renovate PR touching it

This repo's own published packages are cross-referenced via plain semver ranges (not workspace:), and their interdependency versions are managed by release-please as part of this repo's own release process - not Renovate
Group vitest with its coverage plugin
Keep @types/node aligned with the Node 24 runtime major
Automerge safe devDependency patch/minor updates once CI is green
Never automerge major updates - always requires manual review
